result.summary: Found 1 visual issue. The main content looks generally intact; horizontally clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff were ignored as requested.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal line appears across the bottom navigation area, cutting through the search and bookmark icons. It looks like a misplaced gesture indicator, divider, or overlay and makes the navigation bar appear broken.
issues.suggestion: Check the bottom navigation and safe-area layout/z-index. Move the gesture/home indicator to the bottom safe area or remove the unintended overlay so it does not intersect the nav icons.
